title: Japan Multi-City: The Ultimate Car Culture & Family Adventure: Tokyo → Osaka → Kyoto → Nagoya → Tokyo
description: A road through Japan for first-time visitors who love cars. Late-night meets at Daikoku PA, Toyota Museum production lines, Golden Week festivals, hidden ramen shops — weaving car culture into a family-friendly adventure across four cities.

days.title: Welcome to Tokyo
days.description: Land, settle in, and taste Tokyo’s energy in Shinjuku.

activities.name: Arrive at Narita/Haneda
activities.description: Clear immigration, grab WiFi/eSIM, load Suica. Narita Express to Shinjuku (~90 min). Drop bags in Shinjuku — central, connected, buzzing.
details: Fill out Visit Japan Web before landing

activities.name: Shinjuku Night Walk
activities.description: Kabukicho gate, Godzilla head on Toho Building, Omoide Yokocho yakitori alley under the tracks.
details: Godzilla Head visible from street level

days.title: Old Tokyo Meets Otaku Paradise
days.description: Senso-ji temple, Akihabara gaming, Super Autobacs JDM shopping.

activities.name: Senso-ji Temple & Nakamise
activities.description: Tokyo’s oldest temple (645 AD). Thunder Gate, 90+ stalls. Arrive by 8am.

activities.name: Akihabara Electric Town
activities.description: Anime/gaming capital. Super Potato retro games, Tamiya model cars, massive arcades. Japan’s famous automotive megastore. 3 floors JDM parts, accessories, rare merch.

activities.name: Ueno Park & Zoo
activities.description: Ueno Zoo with pandas. Tokyo National Museum with samurai armor. Late cherry blossoms possible.

days.title: Fashion, Shrines & JDM Night Tour
days.description: Shibuya Crossing, Harajuku kawaii, Meiji Shrine — then Friday night at Daikoku PA.

activities.name: Shibuya Crossing & Shibuya SKY
activities.description: World’s busiest crossing. SKY rooftop: 360° views, Mt. Fuji on clear days.

activities.name: Harajuku & Takeshita Street
activities.description: Kawaii central. Crepes, purikura, giant cotton candy. Tranquil shrine in 170 acres of forest. Massive torii, ema wishes.

activities.name: 🚗 Daikoku PA JDM Night Tour
activities.description: FRIDAY NIGHT — prime Daikoku time! Guided tour: expressways, Tatsumi PA, Daikoku PA. GT-Rs, Supras, RX-7s, itasha. The heart of Japan’s car culture.
details: Book Samurai Car Japan or Niche Tours (~¥15,000-20,000/pp)
tips: 🚗 Saturday night works too. Tour is the ONLY way for tourists to reach Daikoku PA.

days.title: teamLab, Toyota MEGA WEB & Tokyo Bay
days.description: Tsukiji grazing, teamLab digital art, Toyota showcase, Rainbow Bridge sunset.

activities.name: Tsukiji Outer Market
activities.description: Legendary outer market. Tamagoyaki, tuna skewers, strawberry daifuku. Best before 10am. Boundaryless digital art. Waterfalls of light, flowers chasing you. Pre-book required.
details: Must-try: tamagoyaki, tuna sticks, melon pan

activities.name: 🚗 Toyota MEGA WEB / History Garage
activities.description: Toyota’s showcase on Odaiba. Test drives, vintage 2000GTs, AE86s, Supras, Land Cruisers. 3+ hours for car lovers. 20m Gundam transforms every 30 min. Gundam Base with model kits.
details: Ride One test drive (may need IDP)
History Garage — retro Tokyo + vintage cars
tips: 🚗 History Garage has 2000GTs, AE86s, Supras, Land Cruisers. A car museum disguised as a mall exhibit.

activities.name: Rainbow Bridge Sunset
activities.description: Watch Rainbow Bridge light up. Yurikamome front seat for skyline views.

days.title: Bullet Train to Osaka — Japan’s Kitchen
days.description: Shinkansen to Osaka, Dotonbori street food. Golden Week begins!

activities.name: 🚄 Shinkansen Tokyo → Osaka
activities.description: Hikari from Tokyo to Shin-Osaka (2.5 hrs, JR Pass). Buy ekiben at Gransta. Mt. Fuji right side.

activities.name: Dotonbori Street Food Crawl
activities.description: Osaka’s kuidaore (eat til you drop). Glico Man, mechanical crabs, takoyaki, kushikatsu, okonomiyaki.
details: Glico Running Man — THE Osaka photo

activities.name: Shinsekai & Tsutenkaku
activities.description: Retro Osaka. Tsutenkaku Tower views. Kushikatsu with authentic vibe.

days.title: Osaka Castle, Shopping & Car Spotting
days.description: Osaka Castle history, Shinsaibashi shopping, Amerikamura car culture.

activities.name: Osaka Castle
activities.description: Japan’s most famous castle. Museum, observation deck, gorgeous grounds.

activities.name: Shinsaibashi Shopping
activities.description: 600m covered arcade. Fashion, souvenirs, food. Car-culture neighborhood. Vintage American cars, lowrider influence, car cafés. GW weekend events.
details: Lowriders and muscle cars on display
tips: 🚗 Walk Amerikamura evenings for modified cars, lowriders, custom bikes.

activities.name: Hozenji Yokocho
activities.description: Lantern-lit stone alley. Moss-covered temple. Splash water on moss Buddha for luck.

days.title: Universal Studios Japan — Full Day
days.description: Super Nintendo World, Harry Potter, Jurassic World. Buy Express Pass for Golden Week!

activities.name: Universal Studios Japan
activities.description: Super Nintendo World: life-sized Mario with Power-Up Bands, Mario Kart AR, Yoshi’s Adventure. Wizarding World of Harry Potter. Arrive at gate opening.
details: Super Nintendo World — timed entry or arrive early
tips: Download USJ app for wait times. Charge your phones!

days.title: Kyoto — Temples, Bamboo & Golden Pavilion
days.description: Day trip from Osaka. Fushimi Inari, Arashiyama bamboo, Kinkaku-ji, Nishiki Market.

activities.name: Fushimi Inari Shrine
activities.description: 10,000 vermillion torii gates. JR Osaka→Kyoto (30 min) then to Inari (5 min). Go EARLY.
details: Full hike: 2-3 hrs, lower loop: 45 min

activities.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
activities.description: Towering bamboo stalks. 500m unforgettable path. Togetsukyo Bridge, Monkey Park nearby.

activities.name: Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion)
activities.description: Gold-leaf Zen temple reflected in mirror pond. Japan’s most photographed building. 400-year-old food market. Pickles, mochi, matcha sweets, seafood samples.

activities.name: Return to Osaka
activities.description: JR back to Osaka (30 min). Relax at hotel or revisit Dotonbori for nighttime energy.
details: Last trains to Osaka run until ~midnight

days.title: Nagoya — Toyota’s Birthplace
days.description: Shinkansen to Nagoya. Toyota Commemorative Museum — the crown jewel for car lovers.

activities.name: 🚄 Shinkansen Osaka → Nagoya
activities.description: Hikari from Shin-Osaka to Nagoya (50 min, JR Pass).

activities.name: 🚗 Toyota Commemorative Museum
activities.description: Set in Toyota’s original factory. Live demos of engine casting to final assembly. Automobile Pavilion traces Toyota AA to modern hybrids. Technoland zone for kids.
tips: 🚗 This is Toyota’s actual birthplace. The looms that funded the car company are on display too.

activities.name: Nagoya Castle
activities.description: Iconic castle with gold shachihoko (tiger-fish) roof ornaments. Honmaru Palace reconstruction shows incredible Edo-era artwork. Castle grounds are beautiful.

days.title: Toyota Automobile Museum & Atsuta Shrine
days.description: The Toyota Automobile Museum in Nagakute — 140+ cars from around the world. Then Atsuta Shrine, one of Japan’s most sacred.

activities.name: 🚗 Toyota Automobile Museum (Nagakute)
activities.description: Unlike the Commemorative Museum (which is about manufacturing), this museum showcases 140+ beautifully restored cars from Toyota AND global manufacturers. European classics, American muscle, JDM legends side by side. The Cultural Wing shows how cars shaped Japanese society.
details: Take Linimo Line from Fujigaoka → Geidai-dori
Gift shop has amazing diecast models
tips: 🚗 CAR HIGHLIGHT: This museum has a Ford Model T, Bugatti Type 35, classic Corvettes, AND JDM legends like the Skyline GT-R and LFA. Truly global car history.

activities.name: Atsuta Shrine
activities.description: One of Japan’s most sacred Shinto shrines, housing the legendary Kusanagi sword (one of three Imperial Regalia). Ancient camphor trees, serene grounds. A spiritual palate cleanser after two days of car museums. Nagoya’s answer to Akihabara meets flea market. Retro games, vintage clothing, street food, and the occasional car-themed shop. Less tourist-oriented than Tokyo’s equivalents.

activities.name: Nagoya TV Tower & Hisaya Odori Park
activities.description: Japan’s oldest TV tower (1954). The park below has been revitalized with trendy shops and cafés. Nice evening stroll with the tower lit up.

days.title: Back to Tokyo — Golden Week Vibes
days.description: Shinkansen back to Tokyo for the final stretch. Explore Ikebukuro’s Sunshine City and evening anime culture.

activities.name: 🚄 Shinkansen Nagoya → Tokyo
activities.description: Hikari from Nagoya to Tokyo (1 hr 40 min, JR Pass). Check into your Tokyo hotel for the last 4 nights.

activities.name: Ikebukuro Sunshine City
activities.description: Massive entertainment complex. Sunshine Aquarium on the rooftop, Namjatown theme park (indoor), and J-World (anime theme park area). Pokemon Center and Capcom store too. The world’s largest anime goods store. 10 floors of manga, figures, DVDs, cosplay supplies. Even casual fans enjoy browsing.
details: Free entry — just a mega store

activities.name: Golden Week Festival Hunting
activities.description: Golden Week means festivals everywhere. Check local listings for matsuri near your hotel — street food stalls, games, taiko drums, and mikoshi (portable shrine) processions. Ask your hotel concierge for the nearest one.
details: Street food stalls at every matsuri
tips: Golden Week = festivals! Check hotel concierge for nearby matsuri. The experience is magical for first-time Japan visitors.

days.title: Tokyo’s Coolest Neighborhoods & Car Cafés
days.description: Explore Tokyo’s hippest local neighborhoods. Vintage shopping, car-themed cafés, and the real Tokyo that tourists miss.

activities.name: Shimokitazawa
activities.description: Tokyo’s bohemian village. Vintage clothing shops, tiny cafés, record stores, and a laid-back vibe. Recently redeveloped with the Shimokita Ekiue above the station. Great for families who want to see non-tourist Tokyo.

activities.name: Nakano Broadway
activities.description: Four floors of otaku paradise — less crowded and cheaper than Akihabara. Rare figures, vintage toys, retro games, and Mandarake (Japan’s best second-hand anime/manga chain). Car model shops too. If you’re serious about Nissan performance cars, Nismo’s headquarters in Tsurumi (Yokohama) sometimes offers showroom visits. Call ahead. Even driving past the facility is thrilling for GT-R fans.

activities.name: Koenji Evening Stroll
activities.description: Tokyo’s counterculture hub. Live music venues, vintage shops, izakaya-lined streets. Raw, authentic, zero tourists. The kind of neighborhood that makes you fall in love with Tokyo.
details: 2 stops from Shinjuku on Chuo Line

days.title: Hakone — Mt. Fuji Views & Mountain Roads
days.description: Day trip to Hakone. Hot springs, Mt. Fuji views, pirate ships, and the legendary mountain roads car enthusiasts dream about.

activities.name: Romancecar to Hakone
activities.description: Take the Odakyu Romancecar from Shinjuku (85 min, reserved seats, scenic). Buy the Hakone Freepass for unlimited transport in the Hakone area — ropeway, pirate ship, bus, train. Japan’s first open-air art museum. Sculptures by Picasso, Moore, and others set against mountain scenery. Kids love running between the installations. The Picasso Pavilion is surprisingly good.

activities.name: 🚗 Hakone Mountain Roads (Scenic)
activities.description: If weather permits, the views of the winding mountain roads from the bus/ropeway are incredible. These are the roads that inspired Initial D’s mountain passes. The Hakone Turnpike is a legendary touge (mountain pass) in JDM culture.
details: Views from ropeway show the switchbacks
If you rent a car, you can drive these roads
tips: 🚗 CAR INSIGHT: Hakone’s mountain passes are sacred in JDM culture. The Hakone Turnpike inspired countless manga and anime racing scenes. Even from the bus, the hairpin turns are thrilling.

activities.name: Lake Ashi Pirate Ship & Mt. Fuji Views
activities.description: Board a pirate ship replica across Lake Ashi. On clear days, Mt. Fuji looms perfectly framed across the water. Kids love the ship; adults love the views. Active volcanic valley with bubbling sulfur vents. Try the famous black eggs — boiled in sulfuric hot springs, they’re said to add 7 years to your life.

activities.name: Return to Tokyo
activities.description: Romancecar back to Shinjuku (~85 min). Rest up for your final Tokyo days.

days.title: Last Full Day — Luxury Tokyo & Final Car Spots
days.description: Ginza luxury shopping, Tokyo Tower, and squeezing in any last car culture or sightseeing you missed.

activities.name: Ginza District
activities.description: Tokyo’s luxury shopping boulevard. Even if you’re not buying, the architecture is stunning. The Nissan Crossing showroom on Ginza’s main intersection has free entry and shows off concept cars and the latest GT-R. Nissan’s flagship showroom right on Ginza’s iconic Sukiyabashi crossing. Concept cars, GT-R displays, Nismo merchandise, and interactive driving simulators. Free entry, and the café on the upper floor has great views.
details: Nissan Crossing — free showroom with concept cars
GT-R, Z, and concept cars on display
tips: 🚗 Nissan Crossing is a must for car fans. Free entry, GT-R displays, concept cars, and Nismo merch. Perfect last car stop.

activities.name: Tokyo Tower
activities.description: The 333m orange-and-white tower (1958) still charms. Less crowded than Skytree and more photogenic. Main Deck at 150m has great views. The retro vibe feels perfectly Tokyo. Last chance for souvenirs! Don Quijote (Donki) has everything. Tokyo Station’s Character Street has official shops for Pokemon, Ghibli, Sanrio, and more.

activities.name: Farewell Dinner
activities.description: Splurge on your last Tokyo night. Options: high-end sushi omakase, premium yakiniku, or a traditional kaiseki (multi-course) experience. This is the meal you’ll remember forever.
details: Alternatively: revisit your favorite spot from the trip

days.title: Sayonara Japan — Until Next Time
days.description: Final morning in Tokyo. Last-minute shopping or a peaceful temple visit before heading to the airport.

activities.name: Last Morning Options
activities.description: Choose your finale: (A) Revisit Tsukiji for one last seafood breakfast, (B) Early morning at Meiji Shrine for peaceful reflection, or (C) Last-minute shopping at Don Quijote or Shinjuku department stores. Narita Express from Shinjuku (~90 min) or Limousine Bus. Allow 3 hours before your flight for Golden Week airport crowds. Buy last souvenirs in the airport — Tokyo Banana, KitKat varieties, Royce chocolate.
details: Pack bags and send luggage ahead via takuhaibin (¥2,000-3,000)
Hotel can arrange luggage forwarding to airport
Leave time for the train to airport
Allow extra time for GW crowds
Airport has great souvenir shops after security
tips: Use takuhaibin (luggage delivery) to send bags to the airport from your hotel. It costs ~¥2,000 and means you can sightsee bag-free on your last morning. Game-changer.
